items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: I mean when I was in high school I was performing with Ellis Marsalis at a club... called Lu and Charlie’s.

ctx.x: Before you left for Eastman, we’ll get to that in a minute, but was there enough work for you as a musician in New Orleans?

Yeah it was weird. I mean when I was in high school I was performing with Ellis Marsalis at a club, you probably are familiar, called Lu and Charlie’s. I don’t know if you’re familiar with Lu and Charlie’s?
